trigger_definition.signal: SPY close-to-close rolling 5-common-session return crosses from above -1.00% to <= -1.00%.
trigger_definition.deduplication: One signal on a downward crossing; while the rolling return remains <= -1%, there is no repeat. A later signal requires a recovery above -1% followed by a new downward crossing.
trigger_definition.correlation_gate: None; no QQQ/SPY correlation filter is applied.
trigger_definition.entry_timing: Select options on the signal-day close and seek entry on the next common session, subject to exact-contract quotes and displayed-size checks.
trigger_definition.costs: Existing replay assumptions: $0.05 per option-share per side plus $0.65 per contract per side.

virtual_lock_definition.primary_condition: After each trade's entry, SPY must never close below 90% of its own entry-date close until the resolved exit date.
virtual_lock_definition.mechanism: Ex-post path conditioning only; trades that breach the floor are excluded from the primary conditional subset rather than liquidated at -10%. No hypothetical stop P&L is applied.
virtual_lock_definition.observation: Daily close prices on common QQQ/SPY sessions; intraday breaches can be missed.

ratio_arms.1x3: 1 QQQ LONG PUT : 3 SPY SHORT PUTs; QQQ reference abs-Delta 0.60-0.70.
ratio_arms.1x6: 1 QQQ LONG PUT : 6 SPY SHORT PUTs; QQQ reference abs-Delta 0.60-0.70.
ratio_arms.2x6: 2 same-expiry lower-premium QQQ LONG PUTs targeting 50% of the 1x6 reference unit ask, : 6 SPY SHORT PUTs; reference expiry/SPY selector locked, alternative QQQ Delta unconstrained.
ratio_arms.2x6_samecontract: 2 QQQ LONG PUTs of the exact 1x6 reference contract, : 6 SPY SHORT PUTs, only where displayed size permits.

source.underlying_prices: QQQ and SPY underlying_prices.parquet, downloaded/hash-verified by engine when absent

limitations: The 10% entry-price floor is a hindsight filter, not a rule known at entry. This report does not model liquidating any option leg when SPY breaches the floor.
All P&L is a historical end-of-day quote-side estimate, not a verified multi-leg fill.
Cohorts overlap; episode sums and episode-sums-per-year are not account NAV returns or CAGR.
No account capital, assignment cash, margin, forced liquidation, financing, tax or portfolio NAV model.
SPY close data are price closes, not dividend-adjusted total returns; intraday floor breaches can be missed.
Unresolved episodes and resolved episodes with missing path data are not included in P&L summary statistics.
